title: VerificationReport
description: The evidence attached to any 'done', 'fixed', or 'works' claim. Separates what was verified from what could not be, and names the residual risk. Enforces Principle 6.

claim.description: The exact claim being supported ('the parser bug is fixed', 'the report reconciles').

rung.description: Verification ladder rung. 0 = unchecked assertion. 1 = it parses/compiles. 2 = it runs without error. 3 = it produces the right output on a representative case. 4 = it passes the relevant test suite. 5 = observed correct in the target environment. See references/verification.md.

how.description: The exact check run (command, test, query, observation).

result.description: What was observed. Include the salient output.

why.description: Why it could not be checked here (no credentials, no environment, cannot be simulated).

unverified.description: Properties that could not be verified. An empty array asserts full verification.

residual_risk.description: The plain-language risk that remains given what is unverified. Empty only when unverified is empty.

failures.description: Anything that failed or was skipped, reported verbatim. Silence here is a failure of Principle 6.
